name: pixly
description: Create, run and manage your Pixly Minecraft servers.

interface.longDescription: Manage the Minecraft servers in your Pixly account. Create a server, start or stop it, change its settings, mods and plugins, read the console, and create or restore backups. Servers sleep when nobody is playing and wake when a player joins.
defaultPrompt: List my Pixly servers and tell me which ones are running.
Create a Paper survival server called Weekend SMP.
Back up my server, then show me its latest console output.
